0: As you step into the Terraformed Pyramid Ship, dark corridors stretch ahead, pulsing with eerie energy. The path is mostly straightforward, but pockets of darkness can drain your life if you linger. A short platforming section follows where careful jumps are needed to avoid falling into the abyss. As you progress, the shifting contrast between Light and Darkness hints at the mechanics ahead.

Pushing forward, you enter a massive chamber glowing orange. This is the start of Cataclysm (1st encounter). Glowing nodes mark your path, and enemies wait to engage. The fight revolves around the Field of Light buff and defeating Tormentors to keep the timer going. Now it is time to take on the first encounter.

The goal of this encounter is to activate and extend the Field of Light buff to progress across the arena while managing a wipe timer. Players must pass the buff between nodes while eliminating Tormentors, who extend the timer when defeated. Successfully linking all nodes leads to the encounter's completion.

The arena is a large, open space divided into sections, with glowing nodes scattered throughout. A central structure houses the initial Field of Light node. Enemies spawn in waves, including Psions, Colossuses, and the Tormentors, which appear at set intervals.
Buff Runners: Two players take turns activating and transferring the Field of Light buff by standing near nodes in sequence.
Add Clear: Three players focus on controlling enemy spawns, ensuring runners can move safely.
Tormentor Slayer: One player is dedicated to quickly locating and eliminating Tormentors, as killing them extends the timer.

Players must interact with the Field of Light node to gain the buff, then find and activate additional nodes by standing near them. The buff expires after a short time, requiring precise movement and coordination. Killing Tormentors prevents a wipe by refreshing the encounter timer.
There is no dedicated DPS phase in this encounter. The focus is on completing node activations while keeping enemies under control.
✔️ - Keep communication clear between runners and the team to ensure efficient node activations.
✔️ - Assign a player to call out Tormentor spawn locations to eliminate them quickly.
❌ - Do not ignore Psions, as they spawn bubble shields that can disrupt movement.
❌ - Avoid spreading out too much, as staying grouped helps control enemies and keeps runners safe.
1: After completing the first encounter, a path forward opens deeper into the Pyramid Ship. Follow the glowing pathways and traverse a series of platforming sections. The architecture shifts, blending Light and Darkness elements as you progress.

Along the way, you will encounter launch pads that propel you across gaps. These pads are key to reaching the next area, so time your jumps carefully. Enemies will appear in some sections, but combat is minimal. Keep moving forward until you enter a new chamber where the Scission encounter begins.

After completing the first encounter, as you ascend the white tendril platforms, look up and to the right to find an alcove. Enter the hallway, follow the path down a set of stairs, and clear the enemies inside. The chest is located in front of a large statue at the end of the room.

The goal of Scission (2nd encounter) is to move across a split-level arena using launch pads while activating nodes to extend bridges. Players must coordinate Field of Light and Flux of Darkness buffs to progress while managing enemies.

The arena is divided into two levels, separated by a large gap. Players must use launch pads to cross between sides while activating nodes in the correct sequence. Enemies spawn on both levels, including Psions, Colossuses, and Tormentors, which must be eliminated to maintain the encounter timer.
Buff Runners: Two players, one for each side, activate and pass the Field of Light and Flux of Darkness buffs by standing near nodes.
Add Control: Three players clear enemies, ensuring the Runners can move safely.
Tormentor Slayer: One player quickly eliminates Tormentors to prevent a wipe.
Players must use launch pads to switch between levels while activating the correct sequence of Light and Dark nodes.
Each activation extends a bridge, allowing the team to progress further.
Killing Tormentors extends the timer, ensuring enough time to complete the node connections.
There is no dedicated DPS phase in this encounter. Success depends on efficient node activations and add management.
✔️ - Coordinate launch pad usage to avoid players being stranded or knocked off.
✔️ - Call out Tormentor spawns and eliminate them quickly to keep the timer active.
❌ - Do not activate nodes out of order, as it can disrupt progress.
❌ - Avoid standing too close to the edge of launch pads, as mistimed jumps can send players off the map.
2: Before reaching the main jumping puzzle, you'll step into a room with a floating disc at its center. To move forward, you’ll need to link the Light and Darkness plates scattered around to this disc. Once both are connected, the real platforming section begins.

After completing the plates puzzle, you’ll enter a long traversal section filled with shifting platforms, launch pads, and Light and Darkness nodes that must be activated in sequence to maintain buffs and open the path forward. As you progress, you’ll notice a floating pyramid in the distance, glowing brighter over time. Every 15 seconds, it unleashes a massive explosion that will wipe anyone not under the Refuge of Darkness buff. To survive, one fireteam member must activate Darkness plates, while the rest push forward using gravity cannons and clearing enemies.

During the second half of the jumping puzzle, after your fireteam opens a door leading to a staircase, climb up and run slightly to your right. Look over the edge of the structure and spot a Darkness crux below. Shooting it will unlock a hidden room directly behind you, where the second secret chest awaits

Your fireteam faces Zo’Aurc, Explicator of Planets, a powerful Cabal Incendior with the ability to shift planets. The goal is to correctly align Light and Dark planets on designated plates, triggering the DPS phase. Players must coordinate planet swaps, defeat enemies, and stand on the correct plates to deal damage to Zo’Aurc before the timer expires.

The arena is a massive planetary display chamber with four triangular plates on the ground, one in each corner. Above, eight planets hover, split between Light and Dark alignments. In the center, Zo’Aurc waits, surrounded by three large DPS plates. Lieutenant Colossuses spawn at each plate, and adds flood the arena, making enemy control essential.
Planet Shifters:Four players, one assigned to each corner, responsible for identifying and moving planets.
Add Clear:Two players focus on killing enemies while avoiding Lieutenants, ensuring a clear space for planet swaps.
Each Planet Shifter defeats their Lieutenant Colossus, gaining the Planetary Insight buff.
Look up and identify the planet that does not match the others in your section (Light or Dark).
Call out the planet’s position to your team.
Swap sides with your assigned partner and interact with the planet they called out.
Kill another set of Lieutenants, then check the three central DPS plates.
Three players interact with the planets above the DPS plates, ensuring Light planets are placed by left-side players and Dark planets by right-side players.
Shoot the crux in the center of the arena to start the DPS phase.

Zo’Aurc will glow either white (Light) or orange (Dark). Players must stand on the matching DPS plate to damage him. The boss becomes immune after taking about 10% HP damage, forcing players to quickly swap to the next plate. This repeats across three plates before the encounter resets. If Zo’Aurc is not defeated in three damage cycles, he enrages, wiping the team.
✔️ - Keep clear communication when identifying planets to prevent mistakes.
✔️ - Use Gjallarhorn and Rocket Launchers for efficient burst DPS.
❌ - Do not stand on the wrong DPS plate, as you will be unable to damage the boss.
❌ - Avoid killing Lieutenants if you are not a Planet Shifter, as their buff is required to interact with planets.
3: As you progress, you'll once again interact with Light and Dark nodes, activating them in sequence to unlock the way forward. Enemies appear sporadically, but the main challenge is navigating the platforming sections. Stay alert for any sudden shifts in terrain and use gravity cannons to launch across large gaps.

Eventually, you'll reach a towering doorway leading into a vast, dimly lit chamber. This is Nezarec’s lair, the final encounter of the Root of Nightmares raid. His presence fills the room, and the battle is about to begin.

The goal of this encounter is to charge Light and Darkness nodes on each side of the arena while managing Nezarec’s Hatred debuff to prevent team wipes. Players must complete six node activations per side, then synchronize the final activation to stun Nezarec and begin the DPS phase. Successfully damaging Nezarec through multiple cycles will lead to victory.

The arena is a large, circular chamber divided into two sides: Light (left) and Dark (right). Nodes are scattered throughout, with one active node per side at any time. Nezarec floats in the center, launching powerful attacks while adds, Colossuses, and Lieutenants, spawn across the arena. Three central DPS plates will be used during the damage phase.
Plate Runners: Two or four players assigned to activate Light and Dark nodes to complete the chain.
Taunters: Two players responsible for drawing Nezarec’s aggro by damaging his shoulders and chest, keeping him from targeting runners.
Add Clear: Two players focusing on eliminating Cabal enemies to protect the runners and taunters.
Plate Runners start the encounter by activating the aura-emitting node on their side, gaining either Field of Light (left) or Flux of Darkness (right).
Runners must activate six plates in sequence while refreshing their buff at the aura-emitting node.
The final node on both sides must be activated at the same time to prevent a wipe and stun Nezarec.
Nezarec’s Hatred randomly afflicts a player, causing continuous damage and launching them into the air.
Taunters can steal Nezarec’s aggro by shooting his shoulders and chest, resetting the debuff timer.

Nezarec releases an explosion of Light or Darkness after being stunned. The team must create the correct Refuge buff to survive his wipe mechanic by transferring Light or Dark energy to the opposite side.
After Nezarec is stunned, players gather on one of the three DPS plates and drop a Well of Radiance.
Nezarec will glow either white (Light) or orange (Dark). Players must stand on the matching plate to deal damage.
Nezarec becomes immune after three DPS plates, resetting the encounter.
If he is not defeated within three damage cycles, he enters Final Stand, requiring a quick burn before triggering a wipe mechanic.
✔️ - Keep communication clear between runners and taunters to prevent delays in node activation.
✔️ - Use Rocket Launchers (Gjallarhorn + Legendary Rockets) for efficient DPS.
❌ - Do not delay activating the final nodes, as Nezarec will wipe the team if they are not synced.
❌ - Avoid standing outside of the correct DPS plate, as only players in the matching aura can damage Nezarec.
